desc: Select approach: reserved-half two-pointer greedy with lower half as candidate tops and upper half as candidate bottoms.

Implement the complete Python program using the O(N) two-pointer greedy: read N and A from stdin, set limit = N // 2, i = 0, j = N // 2, ans = 0; while i < limit and j < n: if 2 * A[i] <= A[j] then ans += 1 and i += 1; always j += 1; print ans.
Verify the implementation on the provided samples and edge cases (N=2, odd N, all equal, large values) using integer arithmetic.
